## 8. Label-edge noise — REPORT ONLY (does NOT change the 10 s rule or any v1 training role)

Bins of seconds_to_nearest_boundary (0 = window crosses a label change). Median feature per bin; windows are grouped by their majority label. If labels were exact, medians would not depend on the bin.
